struct beacon_snb_t

Structure for Secure Network Beacon.

Public Members

uint8_t key_refresh_flag

Key refresh flag indicating current Network Key phase. Phase 1: old NetKey + Key Refresh flag set to 0. Phase 2: new NetKey + Key Refresh flag set to 1. Phase 3: new NetKey + Key Refresh flag set to 0.

uint8_t iv_update_flag

IV update flag signaling current IV Index mode. Normal: new iv index + iv_update_flag set to 0. Update: old iv index + iv_update_flag set to 1.

uint8_t rfu

Reserved for future use bits.

uint8_t net_id[8]

Network ID for secure network beacon.

uint8_t iv_index[4]

IV Index for managing network updates.

uint8_t auth[8]

Authenticates the packet contents, computed with the Network Key over the [KR, NID, CIVI] fields.
